title: SpinZero review bundle (bom-detailed) v1.0
description: Everything a detailed BOM review is allowed to upload — and, by omission, everything it must not. The desktop app builds exactly this set (src-tauri/src/reviewbundle.rs), shows it to the user before sending, and the service rejects any file not named here (spinzero-private/service/src/bundle.ts). Board and schematic geometry, gerbers, project files and datasheet PDFs are never uploaded; the service fetches datasheets itself.

profile.description: End-application profile; decides which rules fire and at what severity.

files.description: Bundle-relative path → file text. Only the properties below are accepted.

bom_enriched.csv.description: The extractor's enriched review BOM: one row per BOM line with sourcing/compliance fields resolved into stable columns.

bom_enriched.mapping.json.description: The extractor's column-mapping report (which property fed which logical field, at what coverage). Lets the engine tell a genuinely missing field apart from a column it failed to recognize — the difference between a real finding and a confident false one.

design_meta.json.description: Board context with no identity in it: a HASH of the project name, the profile, design tool, component and BOM-line counts, extraction id, app version. Never the project name, file paths, net names or geometry.

datasheets/manifest.json.description: Optional MPN → locally-fetched datasheet manifest, when the app already has one. The PDFs themselves are never uploaded.
